claims.quote: Volume repletion with saline is an essential element of care.

claims.text: Isotonic saline 1 to 2 L over 2 to 4 h (unless significant heart failure) plus a loop diuretic to raise urinary Ca
claims.quote: Another treatment is increasing urinary calcium excretion by giving isotonic saline plus a loop diuretic. Initially, 1 to 2 L of saline is given over 2 to 4 hours unless significant heart failure is present
